correctness.rationale: On x2=1 with t=x3 and q=x7 units, the four explicit source equations vanish on the eight cubics parametrizing Han–Kwak Example 6.3. F4 eliminates E and adjoining a formal square root s of t gives an invertible linear coordinate substitution U0=A/q,U1=sC/q,U2=D-U0,U3=B/s-U1. Independent exact SymPy simplification confirmed the three stated Hankel minors equal F2/q-F1/q^2, F3/(qs), 2F2/q-F1/q^2 respectively, with residual expressions all identically zero. The standard 2x2 minors define the prime Veronese subring C[u^3,u²v,uv²,v³]; the original irreducible image is birational on D=x5 !=0 and both defining primes have dimension four, giving localized scheme equality, not merely tangent-cone equality. The transverse 1/3(1,1) quotient has index three, multiplicity three, klt/noncanonical age 2/3; blowup exceptional P1 has normal degree -3 and discrepancy -1/3 by adjunction. A formal local square root is legitimate only after t invertible near each point. The proof does not classify other singular components.
